corrected_content.problem: Find a Cartesian equation of the plane that passes through the point $P(1,0,6)$ and is perpendicular to the vector $\mathbf{n}=⟨1,1,-1⟩.$.
corrected_content.worked_solution:
Use the normal vector $\mathbf{n}=\langle1,1,-1\rangle$ and the point $P(1,0,6)$:

$$
\mathbf{n}\cdot(\mathbf{r}-\mathbf{p})=0\quad\Longrightarrow\quad(x-1)+y-(z-6)=0.
$$

Simplifying gives

$$
x+y-z+5=0.
$$
